messages.content: Too small, doesn't fit. Not as described.

seller_records.listing_text: Size chart in photos. M = chest 100 cm.

ground_truth.why: Decided by Claudia 2026-10-17. Fit is not 'not as described'. Ask the buyer for proof the shirt does not match the size in the listing (e.g. a photo of the label) and offer an exchange as goodwill. Do not rely on a chest measurement the buyer reports: it cannot be verified.
